body.input: The Halvorsen Lab keeps its calibration rig, nicknamed Old Marigold, in room B-117. Booking Old Marigold requires a green badge. Sessions on the rig last at most 90 minutes. The rig is recalibrated every second Thursday by the duty technician.
Conference travel at Halvorsen Lab is approved by Ingrid Tveit. The daily meal allowance is 41 euros. Requests must be filed 18 days before departure.
Spills of cryogenic fluid are reported on extension 4471. The muster point for a fire alarm is the east bicycle shed. Fire drills take place on the first Monday of each quarter.
New staff receive a blue badge on day one. A green badge is granted after passing the Tier 2 safety course, which is offered every six weeks. Every new hire is paired with a mentor for 120 days.
